rows.note: This is the all-purpose affectionate noun, used for a loved person and sometimes a cherished animal or thing.
Use this as an affectionate noun for a cute, well-behaved child or pet rather than for a general adult sweetheart.

example.traditional: 隻狗仔係婆婆最疼愛嘅乖乖。
example.jyutping: zek3 gau2 zai2 hai6 po4 po2 zeoi3 tung4 oi3 ge3 gwaai1 gwaai1

rows.note: Choose this as the all-purpose spoken adjective for something cute, adorable, or charming.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 maau1 zan1 hai6 dak1 ji3

rows.note: Choose this for a person who is dearly loved or cherished, especially in affectionate descriptions such as 親愛嘅老婆.

example.english: My darling wife, you've worked hard.
example.traditional: 我親愛嘅老婆，辛苦你喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 can1 oi3 ge3 lou5 po4 san1 fu2 nei5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a favourite choice or thing, especially when saying it is one of your personal picks.

example.english: This film is a darling of mine.
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hei3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 sam1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for a favoured person or a person or thing especially favoured by a group, as in a media darling.

example.english: This singer is the music scene’s darling this year.
example.traditional: 呢位歌手係今屆樂壇嘅寵兒。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai2 go1 sau2 hai6 gam1 gaai3 ngok6 taan4 ge3 cung2 ji4
